title: Performance log: a machine-readable section with the machine, its load and every run with its solver timers
author: Claude-JG
description: The performance logs are readable by humans only. A JSON section at the end of the log (as the MiniExample performance log has, #2745): the version and module, the machine and its load before and after, every test file with its time and result, every single run with its solver time and, in the regular module, the solver sub-timers; all performance models with the timers active in the regular module.
releaseNotes: The log of the performance tests ends with a machine-readable section (#JSON): version and module, the machine and its CPU load before and after, every test file with its time and result, every single run with its solver time and, in the regular module, the solver sub-timers; all performance models run with the timers active.
